_meta.note: First-run intro takes for Kestrel Heavy (Trevor-approved draft, Nov 14, 2026). Source of truth for generation; run tools/clipgen/gen_intro.py. Each take is one single-speaker line, at most 14 words, no digits. Beat 1 reuses existing Thrum clips (first.1.c1, first.2.c1, first.2.c2) at $0 via hash-skip and is NOT listed here. The Thrum close line lives in data/guide.json as line first.close and is listed here as channel guide so its guide-manifest clip is generated with the batch. No clip in this batch uses Pearl. ElevenLabs output is never used to train/improve any AI model.
_meta.rules: Every line at most 14 words, at most 80 chars, no digits (numbers spoken as words). The booster line is gated on stages>=2 with claims [stages] because the narration facts lint requires a design-fact tag for the word booster; the intro plays on Home and the gate only satisfies the lint. All other narration takes are neutral with a neutralReason. No invented quotes; every fact sourced from data/campaign.json or docs/ECONOMY.md.
